data.title: Word Similarity
data.solution:
a, b = input().split()
same = sum([5 for i in range(min(len(a), len(b))) if a[i]==b[i]])
unique = sum([1 for c in a if c not in b]) + sum([1 for c in b if c not in a])
score = same - unique
print(f"The words have a similarity score of {score}." if score > 0 else "The words are very different.")
data.statement:
Given two words, [[a]] and [[b]], compute their <<similarity score>>.

The [[similarityScore]] of the words is calculated as follows:
- <<Add>> {{5}} points for each character at the <<same position>> in both words. 
- <<Subtract>> {{1}}  point for all unique characters in <<both>> words that do <<not>> appear anywhere in the other. 

<<Note:>> The two words can be of different lengths.

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

Given two words, a and b, compute their similarity score.

The similarityScore of the words is calculated as follows:
- Add 5 points for each character at the same position in both words.
- Subtract 1 point for all unique characters in both words that do not appear anywhere in the other.

Note: The two words can be of different lengths.
Input
Line 1: a b: The two words, separated by a single space.
Output
If the similarity score is less than or equal to 0, output "The words are very different."
Otherwise, output "The words have a similarity score of similarityScore.".
Constraints
5 <= length of a <= 15
5 <= length of b <= 15
a and b will only contain lowercase letters.
Example
Input
grains trains
Output
The words have a similarity score of 23.
